cards.review_notes: The camp page states 'Weeks of June 8th through the end of July' without a year. Assigned 2026 using the homepage's 2026 sign-up notice; confirm year and exact final day. Individual weeks could not be read on the registration platform. Children must be fully potty trained. Each week requires at least six campers; families are notified one week ahead if camp is canceled. A $100 deposit reserves the spot, with $200 charged the Saturday before camp.
